skills.name: Crow Feather (乌翎/烏翎)
skills.line: This is just a small punishment.
skills.description:
SP Kijo Momiji illuminates a single target with focused maple fire before extinguishing the fire, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.
When she is in her Into the Wood state, this skill changes to Leaf Blade. ;Into the Woods (林隐状态/林隠状態) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Max 2 stacks. Reduces by 1 stack after casting Leaf Blade during turn. Increases Indirect Damage taken by 20%, and reduces non-Indirect Damage taken by 20%.

skills.name: Leaf Blade (叶刃)
skills.description: SP Kijo Momiji throws a shard leaf blade to strike a single target which then bounces once, striking a random enemy, dealing damage equal to 75% of her ATK with each strike. The leaf blade bounces to enemies with the highest stacks of Burnt Leaf.

skills.name: Crucible (经霜/経霜)
skills.line: The maple leaves are most beautiful after a crucible.
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
When SP Kijo Momiji attacks an enemy, she inflicts her targets with 1 layer of Burnt Leaf. ;Burnt Leaf (叶烬/葉の灰) : :'''Debuff, Status''': At the start of turn, inflicts indirect damage equal to 10% of SP Kijo Momiji's ATK. Each stack inflicts Grade 3 of Poison, lasts for 2 turns, and increases indirect damage received by 5%. At the end of turn, 1 stack is removed. Max of 5 stacks. Inflicting Burnt Leaf on a target with 5 will inflict Red Erosion instead. ;Red Erosion (红蚀/紅蝕) : :'''Debuff, Mark''': Decreases move bar increasing effects by 50%. When receiving an attack from SP Kijo Momiji, also receives indirect damage equal to 80% of her ATK. Lasts for 2 turns and cannot be removed. If SP Kijo Momiji inflicts this effect outside of her turn, increases her move bar by 40%.

upgrades.text: '''Burnt Leaf''': Indirect damage received increases to 10%.
When an ally is inflicted with a debuff, the source of the debuff is inflicted with 1 stack of Burnt Leaf (only triggers once per turn).
When the move bar of an enemy is increased by at least 30%, they are inflicted with 1 stack of Burnt Leaf.
Each Burnt Leaf stack decreases ATK and DEF by 10%. When SP Kijo Momiji is attacked, each stack also decreases the attack's Crit by 20%.

skills.name: Maple Dance (枫起之舞/楓起の舞)
skills.line: This dance is for you, and you alone.
skills.description:
SP Kijo Momiji dances freely, summoning maple leaves to gain 2 stacks of Into the Woods. During its duration, all allies gain Leaf Buffer.
This skill can only be used when she is not in her Into the Woods state. ;Leaf Buffer (叶之护/葉の守護) : :'''Buff, Mark''': When the unit takes damage, inflicts a stack of Burnt Leaf on the attacker. Triggers once per each turn. ;Into the Woods (林隐状态/林隠状態) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Max 2 stacks. Reduces by 1 stack after casting Leaf Blade during turn. Increases Indirect Damage taken by 20%, and reduces non-Indirect Damage taken by 20%.

upgrades.text: '''Into the Woods''': Her attacks ignore 200 DEF.
'''Into the Woods''': Indirect damage received decreases to 10% and reduction for non-indirect damage received increases to 30%.
'''Upper Hand''': This skill is automatically used at the start of battle.

bio.condition: Increase SP Kijo Momiji's level to 40.
Increase SP Kijo Momiji's skills 8 times.
With SP Kijo Momiji win 10 times in against Kijo Momiji.
